sources.entry: Kite - Powerful animation and prototyping application for Mac & iOS.

summary.name: Kite Compositor
summary.one_liner: Kite Compositor is a native Mac app for designing and prototyping UI animations on a visual canvas, with a timeline, JavaScript scripting, and Core Animation code export.
use_cases: generating Core Animation code for apps
previewing designs on an iOS device
summary.what_it_does: Kite lets users drag and drop layers to build interfaces on a WYSIWYG canvas and add animations tuned in an integrated timeline with editable durations and keyframes. An inspector edits layer properties, animation curves, and Core Image filters. A library stores reusable layer hierarchies as components. The built-in JavaScript engine and console allow scripted interactions and live edits to a running animation. It can generate zero-dependency Swift or Objective-C Core Animation code and export animations as video.
notable: Generates zero-dependency Swift or Objective-C Core Animation code
Built-in JavaScript scripting engine and console for live edits
Companion iOS app for previewing designs on a device
caveats: Listed price is $99 with a trial available
